flows.name: lunar_surface_relay
flows.availability: lunar user-to-satellite geometry and link budget TBD
flows.note: Not implied by PNT broadcast; relay service must be approved as mission requirement.

flows.name: earth_uplink_commands
flows.availability: DSN uplink station and satellite geometry TBD
flows.note: Separate uplink buffer, command validation and acknowledgment; no continuous generation assumed.

allocation_rule: Reserve protected command memory and configurable lunar relay buffer; do not take capacity from housekeeping until rates, burst sizes and coverage are defined.
sizing_formula: required_mbit = peak_incoming_bps * maximum_buffering_seconds / 1e6 + event_burst_mbit; include margins, protocol overhead and redundancy as separate parameters
